codex_amendment: Before any held-out trial the user explicitly requested Codex instead of an Astra API key. Shared task instructions, skills, packet and original image bytes are preserved. Codex adds wrapper context and may preprocess attached images differently. Shell, view-image tools, apps/plugins, browser/computer use, memories and delegation are disabled. Any tool event invalidates the response. Fresh ephemeral sessions prevent prior-episode memory. The model identity is CLI-configured, not an independently returned immutable provider snapshot. No direct-Astra-API equivalence claim.
codex_token_budget: Same 120-second request timeout and post-response 4096 reported output-token acceptance ceiling. Codex CLI has no documented generation-time max_output_tokens option; unlike Qwen, this ceiling cannot prevent oversampling. Report raw usage and flag violations. Hidden reasoning budgets are not matched.
codex_transport_limit: One CLI invocation per decision, with unbounded connection retries disabled. Internal bounded transport retries are not independently controlled or counted. Qwen uses one HTTP attempt. The overall 120-second deadline applies to either route.
order_amendment: Before either model produced any held-out result, reverse the planned within-pair order to start with Astra while the Qwen host's direct SSH connectivity is repaired. No seeds, budgets, physics or acceptance gates changed.
history: All prior compact commands and completion/rejection statuses, latest RGB only; identical construction for both models.
timing: Model request executes asynchronously while simulation runs. Never apply a response before observation_sim_time + measured request wall latency. Record simulator lag and synchronous planner pauses; this is not a real-time deployment claim.
contact_gate_scope: The unintended robot-workpiece contact classification is sampled every 20 ms during the flip only. Peak penetration is checked at physics substeps throughout the episode. The former does not prove absence of unintended contacts during earlier assembly stages.
failure_policy: Count every started trial. Invalid JSON/schema, API failure, skill failure, numerical violation, stop, timeout or premature finish is retained; never silently restart. No tuning on evaluation episodes.
statistics: Report raw n/3 and exact binomial intervals descriptively. Three paired cases cannot establish high reliability or general superiority.
hardware_and_pretraining_matching: Same robot, original sensor image bytes, public packet, skills and downstream data (zero). Different model sizes, pretraining, inference hardware, wrapper context, internal image processing and token-cap enforcement remain confounds; not a representation ablation.
released_pose_amendment: Before any fresh held-out trial, delayed development regression showed an image-only false rejection of a sound frame: single-view rectangle fit exaggerated a corner gap. Extend the existing two-camera silhouette fit to released front/rear members with the same explicit surveyed planar support prior. Missing second-view evidence rejects the estimate; no target snapping or evaluator state. Held-out seeds remain unused. No physics or acceptance change.
codex_reconnect_amendment: v8 trial22001 exposed a wrapper parser defect: a CLI invocation recovered from explicit Reconnecting progress events and completed successfully with a valid action, but the adapter rejected all top-level error events. v9 allows only those progress events before an eventual completed turn. Fatal errors, failed/incomplete turns, tool events, excess tokens and timeouts still fail. Keep v8 interrupted trial; fresh seeds23001..23003. One CLI invocation; no wrapper model retry. Physics/controller identical to validated v8.
